judgingPrinciple: Reward observable native design improvements toward target v2. Exact source part counts, blankness and awkward geometry are not criteria. Judge architecture and decoration by style, readability, function and protected continuity; exact target pixel identity is unnecessary.

rankedAestheticCriteria.success: The canopy reads as shaped architecture with thickness, softened crafted edges and a coherent support relationship. The wall and base gain purposeful structural definition such as molding, brackets, a framed field or panel. At logical size the result clearly improves on the source's flat blocks.
rankedAestheticCriteria.flexibility: Canopy surface forms, proportions within the locked envelope, nonfunctional topology, part counts and interior decorations may change. Target scallops, cream accent, brackets and panel are inspiration; equivalent well-designed native forms are acceptable.

rankedAestheticCriteria.success: Blue remains the dominant canopy family, ochre/golden tan remains the wall family, and honey/amber brown remains the structural wood family. Warm midtones and restrained lighter edges separate these materials without bleaching the wall, turning the wood into saturated orange plastic, or making the canopy electric cyan. Colors fit the frozen entrance family.

Broad soft illumination reveals thickness and rounded transitions. Highlights remain controlled and recesses remain readable. Corresponding left and right structural areas have balanced lighting without a global horizontal bright-to-dark ramp. Local contact shading and designed material variation may describe form; dark strips must not conceal construction. No directional ground cast shadow.

Crafted detail supports the architecture: trim has clear thickness, brackets or supports connect convincingly, and any lower panel has readable depth. Plaster variation and wood grain, if used, remain broad and restrained at intended size. No photographic microtexture, pervasive noisy speckle, generic bevel clutter or uniformly glossy material treatment.

The static S sprite is crisp and legible at logical 192-by-448 and clean enlarged on light, gray and dark backgrounds. No black dead patches, coplanar flicker, pinched corners, jagged normal bands, floating trim, alpha fringes, isolated pixels, accidental bloom or clipping. Decorations remain subordinate to the restaurant backdrop role.

At least three repeated wall modules and wall-to-entrance joins read as deliberate continuous architecture at the authored pitch. Canopy, fascia, field and baseboard bands meet without gaps, exposed terminal faces, doubled borders, sawtooth ends or a light/dark stripe at every tile. New ornament repeats purposefully and does not create accidental heavy pillars. Protected seam profiles may require adapting the target's outer bevels and end decoration.

immutableTechnicalConstraints: 35-degree original character-orthographic view; square pixels; sourceScale 3. Do not substitute a 55-degree world tile projection.
Native static S frame 576-by-1344; logical 192-by-448; logical root (96,416), native root (288,1248); original atlas placement and authored crop-equivalent registration.

Registered projected basis: one horizontal world unit = 384 native pixels, vertical world basis approximately (0,-314.5543) native pixels. Verify actual projection and root; an unchanged global gate camera JSON or ortho_scale alone does not prove wall registration.
One-module horizontal occupancy and three-tile projected backdrop scale; functional footprint, baseline, clearance and neighboring character/object contacts preserved.

Protected left/right join planes, end cross sections, canopy/baseboard boundary heights and repeat cadence remain compatible with the entrance family. Interior remodeling and decoration are authorized.
Required delivery is native editable 3D with one static S frame at 12 fps metadata; no target billboard, painted substitute, per-view image fitting or post-render registration repair.
Balanced horizontal lighting, no directional ground cast shadow, transparent RGBA output, no accidental alpha or gutter defects.
The three excluded restaurant floor designs remain unchanged.
reviewEvidenceRequired: A frozen brief containing agreed quality criteria and family settings, then an immutable exact candidate packet binding source, every supplied native render/preview and technical validation by SHA-256.

Native static S export and declared preview sheet inspected at logical size and enlarged on appropriate backgrounds. The catalog is single-player-facing: the generic four-view-sheet label does not independently authorize inventing new required rotations.
A native repeated wall assembly and native wall-to-entrance context demonstrating actual geometry continuity.

Independently assembled exported sprites for repeated wall and entrance joins, placed using declared roots and pitch; disclose exact entrance sprite/source bytes. Show both left and right entrance connections. No resizing, overlap correction or seam paint.

Native validation for camera transform/projection and pixel basis, final frame and root, footprint/clearance, geometry envelope and protected connector profiles, lights/shadow policy, scene selection and resource closure. Missing evidence yields needs_evidence.
approvalRule: Approve only an exact supplied native candidate that visibly improves the architectural design and warm cartoon finish, satisfies frozen technical and family constraints, and has no material defects in required standalone and assembly evidence. Comparative scores support observations and are not a universal numeric threshold.
